title: com.ottoyard.capacity.offer (OTTO-Q to operator)
description: What the depot holds for this operator in a window, in coarse counts. It never carries another tenant's car ids, charge levels, ETAs or counts (README, rule 4), so the schema admits no vehicle field at all. Informational: no ack.

charge_wait_band.description: How long this operator's next arriving car would wait for a charger, in coarse bands. A band, not a position: a position is an exact count of the cars ahead of yours, and some of them are another tenant's (README, rule 4).
